--- title: "Getting Started on Your Final Project" date: today date-format: long footer: "[DataViz 2102 Website](https://dataviz-gwu.rocks)" logo: images/dataviz-logo.png format: revealjs: theme: [simple, custom.scss] transition: fade slide-number: true #multiplex: true chalkboard: true execute: echo: true eval: false freeze: auto --- # The Final Project 🎯 ## Two tracks
::: {.columns} ::: {.column width="50%"} **Shiny app** 🧭 - An interactive tool that lets a user explore data - The controls should *teach* the user something - Published on Posit Connect Cloud ::: ::: {.column width="50%"} **Report** 📝 - A polished report written in Quarto - Built around at least one well-crafted visualization - Also published on Posit Connect Cloud ::: :::
Same proposal, same studio sessions, same deadlines. See the [Project Description](/project/project-description.qmd). ## What makes a good project? - A **clear question** your audience can explore - **Data** that is comprehensive and convenient (no time for original data collection!) - At least one **well-crafted, labeled visualization** - **App:** controls that change the output in a way that teaches something - **Report:** writing that puts the visualization to work ## Groups - Work **alone or in a group of up to three** - One proposal and one project per group; everyone shares the grade - Divide the work clearly (data wrangling, UI, server logic, writing...) - Include a short **division-of-work note** with your proposal and your final submission ## Timeline
| When | What | |------|------| | **Today** | Kickoff: pick a track, form groups, find data | | **Mon, Nov 23, 11:59 p.m.** | ✍️ [Project proposal](/project/project-assignment-1.qmd) due | | Nov 24--26 | Thanksgiving break 🦃 | | **Tue, Dec 1** | Deploying & sharing (apps *and* reports) + studio | | **Thu, Dec 3** | Shiny modules + studio | | **Tue, Dec 8** | ✍️ [Final project](/project/project-assignment-2.qmd) due before class + lightning talks | ## The proposal Four questions, a paragraph or two each: 1. **Question & track:** What should your audience learn? App or report, and why? Link to examples you like. 2. **Data:** What sources, variables, units and years? How will you merge? 3. **Visualization:** What will they see, and what should they notice? 4. **Interactivity or narrative:** What will the user control (app), or how is the report structured (report)? Submit your unrendered `.qmd` on Blackboard. ## Where to find data - Data we have used in class: **V-Dem**, **World Bank (WDI)**, **FRED**, **UCDP**... - The [Datasets](/project/project-datasets.qmd) page has many more - Pick something you can **load into R today** - If it needs an API key, plan to download once and save to a file ## Scope it small 🔬 - Start with a **proof of concept**: one or two indicators, one chart - Get that working *before* adding more data, inputs or sections - A simple project that works beats an ambitious one that doesn't - You can always add more later ## AI and your project - A full AI-assisted workflow is **encouraged** for the final project - But the design, data choices, analysis and interpretation must be **yours** - You should be able to **explain and defend** everything in your project - Note how you used AI in your final submission # Let's Get Started 🛠️ ## Today's plan 1. **Pick a track and form your group** (10 min) 2. **Browse examples:** the Shiny [gallery](https://shiny.posit.co/r/gallery/), [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/), apps from [Shiny Basics](/modules/module-5.1.qmd) and [Advanced Shiny](/modules/module-5.2.qmd) 3. **Find your data and load it into R**---try a first `glimpse()` and a quick plot 4. **Start drafting your proposal**
I'll come around to talk through ideas with each person or group. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: :::

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
